title: birch beer forest
interpretation: Authored sections and selected accents shape irregular physical rainfall. Timing is repeatable; positions and the original per-drop radius/force variation remain generative.

units.density: mean physical drops per second before bounded analysis modulation
units.strength: multiplier on the existing rain-force control
units.scale: multiplier on the existing rain radius distribution and ripple-scale control
units.pulse: depth of a smooth beat-phase modulation of background density, not one drop per beat
units.bias: small normalized broad x/z attraction of otherwise random rain positions

sections.name: Still opening
sections.note: A real pause in rainfall; low-energy brightness artifacts do not trigger drops.

sections.name: First flecks
sections.note: A few small, widely separated impacts as the opening becomes audible.

sections.name: Gathering
sections.note: Gradually gather rain, then briefly clear space before the rhythm enters.

sections.name: Rhythm arrives
sections.note: The bass-rich rhythmic body receives irregular showers, with a gentle rate pulse rather than beat-triggered drops.

sections.name: Moving detail
sections.note: Brighter activity gets smaller impacts and a restrained drift across the water.

sections.name: Dark pocket
sections.note: Make room in the darker bass-rich passage; fewer, heavier drops. The isolated 118.422 onset has a longer anticipation.

sections.name: Fine shower
sections.note: Higher onset activity brings a finer, busier shower; most attacks still receive no event.

sections.name: Brighter crest
sections.note: A brighter late passage carries small, sharp rain around selected heavier anchors.

sections.name: Full body
sections.note: The higher-energy late body is sustained rather than mapped directly to loudness.

sections.name: Rhythm recedes
sections.note: The tracked rhythm and low-frequency body disappear; let sparse drops and existing waves breathe.

sections.name: Dissolving
sections.note: Taper toward stillness with the recording, while existing physical waves keep fading.

sections.name: Tail stillness
sections.note: No new rain in the silent tail.
